jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Creative Strategy & Performance (Paid Marketing)
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla –
(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)
– A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

About The Role

As a Sr. Creative, you’ll conceptualise and execute innovative, digital-first campaigns that elevate brand identities and engage audiences for our clients in Madrid. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful, thumb-stopping visuals and copy that resonate across the modern digital landscape.

Responsibilities

Conceptualise and execute creative and content campaigns from ideation to delivery.
Collaborate with the Creative Director, strategists, and account teams to develop digital-first ideas that align with brand objectives.
Stay up-to-date with the latest social media trends, platform updates, and best practices to inform creative decisions.
Partner with content creators, influencers, and production teams to bring social media and content ideas to life.
Ensure all creative work aligns with brand guidelines and tone of voice.
Present creative concepts and campaigns to internal teams and clients.
Incorporate client feedback and iterate on creative work to meet project objectives.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.
Mentor and guide junior creatives, fostering a collaborative and creative team environment.

About You

The essentials:

5+ years of experience in a creative role, with a focus on digital media and content creation.
A strong portfolio showcasing innovative creative, digital media, and content campaigns.
Expertise in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns across all digital channels.
Excellent copywriting skills with the ability to adapt to various brand voices and tones.
Proficiency in graphic design and video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite).
Data-informed mindset with an understanding of metrics and the ability to create content that drives engagement.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Strong presentation and communication skills to articulate creative ideas to internal teams and clients.
Resilience to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects, and meet tight deadlines.
Educational background: Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, communications, or a related field.

Not a Must, But a Plus

Experience working within the local Madrid market or with international agency networks.
Advanced knowledge of emerging AI creative tools or motion graphics.

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.description:
As Senior Creative Brand Specialist, you make sure the LYNX brand comes across clearly and consistently in every campaign.

You are the link between our creative agency and our marketing team, you drive our brand and visual identity transformation, and you manage the high-impact brand and performance campaigns that build awareness and bring in new customers.

You work in an agile squad and use campaign data to keep improving what we do.

What You’ll Do

Act as the link between our creative agency and the marketing team, so that our brand messaging and campaigns are effective.
Drive brand and visual identity transformation projects across the company, and manage stakeholder expectations.
Build the annual campaign calendar, get the budget approved, align stakeholders and deliver the calendar on time, supporting key marketing and commercial milestones.
Manage high-impact brand and performance campaigns.
Work with the squad to create cohesive, impactful campaigns that increase brand awareness and consideration, and bring in new customers.
Keep our brand guidelines applied consistently across all assets and campaigns.
Measure brand performance and optimise it based on campaign data, looking at engagement, reach and conversion.

Who You Are

5 or more years of experience in brand, creative or marketing roles.
Fluent in Dutch and English, with strong written and visual storytelling skills.
Proven experience in brand management and cross-channel content creation.
Skilled in creative tools (for example Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma) and analytics platforms.
Experience working in agile or cross-functional teams.
A strong communicator and creative problem solver with a sharp eye for design and brand detail.
Data-informed: you turn insights into creative optimisation, and you can align creative work with business goals.
Proactive and organised, able to manage multiple projects at once, resilient and open to experimentation, and you give and receive constructive feedback.

Nice to have

Experience in finance, tech or agency environments.
Knowledge of performance marketing and campaign measurement frameworks.
Experience collaborating with creative agencies or managing agency output.
Familiarity with cultural trend analysis and brand activation development.

What We Offer

A competitive salary based on experience.
Flexible working hours at our office in the heart of the city.
A fixed 13th-month salary.
Pension scheme.
Travel expense reimbursement.
An annual training budget of €2,000, freely allocated to your professional development.
Team outings, social drinks, and an annual weekend trip with the entire team.

Who We Are

“LYNX helps you invest in yourself.” “Working at LYNX means joining the LYNX family.” “The development opportunities make LYNX the best place to work.”

This is what our employees say about LYNX, and it reflects exactly what we aim to offer: an environment where you can get the best out of yourself.

From our offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Berlin, and Prague, we work every day to provide private and professional clients with the best trading opportunities through a fast, user-friendly, and reliable platform.

LYNX is an international FinTech company where around 300 colleagues contribute to client success across Europe in an informal, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.

READY TO DO WORK YOU'RE PROUD OF?

Charlie Oscar isn't a typical agency. We're independent, AI-native, and built to help ambitious brands outmanoeuvre, outpace and outgrow the competition.

We blend data science with creativity - not because it's fashionable, but because it's how brands actually grow. The numbers give us clarity. The creative work is what wins hearts, builds brands, and drives revenue.

We hire for attitude and culture add first - not just experience. Curious, ambitious people who challenge how things are done, bring fresh ideas, and help shape the future of marketing.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you're already using AI to work smarter, even better.

AI

Collaborate closely with the paid media team to ensure creative assets are optimized for performance across digital platforms.
Provide strategic and creative direction to clients, helping them develop content strategies that drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversion.
Lead ideation sessions and craft compelling campaign concepts that bring brand stories to life.
Identify and stay ahead of digital and social trends, seamlessly blending cultural, audience, data and brand insights into creative outputs that help clients remain cutting-edge.
To have an up to date and forward looking perspective on social-first creative, and be a thought leader in digital advertising creative.
Support new business pitches by providing creative strategic input and developing concepts that showcase our expertise.
Build a team and network of partners, including designers, copywriters, and content creators, to bring ideas to life.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven experience in a creative strategy role within a digital or social agency.
Deep expertise in digital and social media platforms, trends, and best practices.
A brilliant creative storyteller with a track record of developing compelling campaigns.
A strategic thinker who can connect creativity with business impact.
Experience working with performance marketing teams to develop high-performing content.
A strong understanding of brand positioning and audience insights.
Excellent presentation skills – confident in selling ideas both internally and externally.
Entrepreneurial mindset, excited about building a department and growing an offering within an agency

Regular office treats and surprises
Be part of building something truly exceptional
Working on innovative, exciting brands

jobs.description:
About Sidemen Entertainment

Home of one of the most engaged audiences in digital entertainment, Sidemen Entertainment is the engine behind Sidemen Sunday and the wider Sidemen content universe. We create culture-defining moments weekly, pushing creative boundaries and delivering some of the most watched shows online. We move fast, innovate constantly and have a ridiculous amount of fun while doing it.

About The Role

MoreSidemen produces multiple videos every week, bringing together the Sidemen’s personalities through gaming, challenges and studio formats. It’s home to Sidemen Among Us, one of YouTube’s biggest ongoing gaming series, alongside a growing range of new games and IP. With a busy release schedule, we’re looking for someone who can turn strong concepts into standout videos.

Senior / Lead Creative Strategist

Simmer | London | Full-time

Simmer is one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer brands, built on a simple idea: healthy food should taste extraordinary. Founded by brothers Simmy and Jhai with £10 of ingredients, we've grown into a profitable, bootstrapped business generating over £100m in annual recurring revenue, ranking #5 in The Sunday Times 100.

But we still think we're early.

Our ambition is to become the defining brand in healthy eating.

We're fully founder-led, without private equity or corporate layers. The founders remain deeply involved in the business, decisions happen quickly and the people who join us have the opportunity to materially shape what Simmer becomes.

We've built our growth through product quality, performance marketing and founder-led storytelling. Creative has been one of our biggest competitive advantages, helping us reach tens of thousands of customers across the UK.

Now we want to take that advantage much further.

The opportunity

We're looking for an exceptional Senior / Lead Creative Strategist
who understands the relationship between creative, consumer behaviour and commercial performance.

Someone who can look at our acquisition engine, understand what is driving growth today and identify what could make it significantly better tomorrow.

You'll have access to meaningful paid media investment, high volumes of creative testing, rich performance data and a talented team of producers and editors who can bring ideas to life.

You'll work directly with our founder and closely with the people responsible for growth, helping determine which audiences we target, what messages resonate and where we invest our creative efforts.

This isn't a role for someone who simply writes briefs or comes up with interesting ideas.

We want someone who can answer the harder questions:
Why are certain ads outperforming everything else?
Which audiences and customer motivations are we not reaching?
Where are we seeing creative fatigue or diminishing returns, and what should we do about it?
Which new concepts, formats and messages could materially improve acquisition?
How do we turn individual creative wins into a repeatable engine for growth?
Where should we focus our time, creative resources and media investment to generate the greatest return?

You might be a senior Creative Strategist with exceptional performance marketing knowledge, or an experienced Performance Marketer with outstanding creative instincts.

We're open-minded about your background and title. What matters is your ability to combine commercial insight, creative thinking and execution to deliver measurable growth.
For the right person, the role could extend into broader performance marketing ownership.

What you'll do

Own the creative growth opportunity

Understand our acquisition performance, identify the biggest opportunities and develop a clear creative strategy to capture them. Think beyond individual campaigns to customer segments, positioning, messaging and sustainable growth.

Turn performance data into better creative

Go deep into Meta performance, CAC, conversion, creative fatigue, testing results and customer behaviour. Understand why something works, not simply whether it works, and translate those insights into clear creative decisions.

Develop concepts that move the numbers

Create and shape compelling concepts, hooks, scripts and briefs grounded in consumer psychology and commercial insight. Work closely with our production team, editors and creators to turn ideas into high-performing content.

Build a stronger experimentation engine

Identify what we should test, how we should test it and what we'll learn. Develop new angles, challenge assumptions, iterate quickly and scale ideas that demonstrate genuine incremental value.

Connect creative and media performance

Work across creative and performance to understand how messaging, audiences, spend and acquisition economics interact. Help shape decisions around what to produce, what to scale and where to focus investment.

Raise the standard

Develop a strong point of view on what great performance creative looks like. Challenge mediocre ideas, improve the quality of thinking and help the team become more commercially effective without slowing down execution.

Take ownership of outcomes

We're not looking for someone who measures success by how many briefs they've written or campaigns they've launched. We care about what improves as a result of their work.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in how impressive your job title sounds or how many people you've managed than the quality of your thinking, the decisions you've made and the results you've delivered.

You'll bring:
Proven performance impact.
You've helped improve customer acquisition through creative strategy, paid social or a combination of both, and can explain what you personally contributed.
Strong Meta and acquisition knowledge.
You understand the mechanics of paid social, creative testing, CAC, conversion and scaling performance.
Exceptional creative judgement.
You instinctively understand hooks, storytelling, consumer psychology, messaging and what makes people pay attention and take action.
Analytical depth.
You're comfortable working with performance data, spotting patterns, forming hypotheses and making decisions that improve commercial outcomes.
Experience at pace.
You've worked in an environment where creative is tested frequently, feedback is immediate and strong ideas are developed and iterated quickly.
Ownership and ambition.
You're comfortable taking responsibility, challenging assumptions and finding solutions without waiting to be told what to do.
Intellectual curiosity and humility.
You're constantly learning, testing your thinking and willing to change your mind when the evidence says you should.

Why Simmer?

A meaningful growth challenge

We've already built a £100m+ ARR business. The next stage isn't about proving the model works. It's about finding the opportunities that take us much further.

Real scale, without corporate complexity

You'll have meaningful media investment, performance data and creative resources, but still be close enough to the decisions to make things happen quickly.

Work directly with the founder

You'll work closely with Simmy, shaping the creative and commercial decisions that influence how the business grows.

Influence the work, not just the output

We want someone who challenges our thinking, identifies opportunities we've missed and raises the quality of decisions across creative and performance.

A role that can grow with you

We're open-minded about where this role develops. For someone with the right capabilities, there's significant scope to take on broader ownership across creative strategy, performance marketing and growth.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who's commercially sharp, creatively ambitious and intellectually curious.
Someone who can go from analysing acquisition performance to developing an exceptional creative concept, then work with a team to bring it to life.
Someone who has strong opinions but isn't attached to being right.
Someone who values pace, takes ownership and cares as much about commercial results as the quality of the ideas.
Most importantly, someone who's excited by the opportunity to make a measurable difference to one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer businesses.

If you love understanding why creative works, identifying growth opportunities others miss and turning those insights into commercial results, we'd love to hear from you.
